mutations.name: skip-referent-shell
mutations.from: validateSemanticReferent(value); // Structural failure precedes the narrower role.

mutations.name: replace-qualification-error-carrier
mutations.from: throw new StateContractError('CANONICAL_ROLE_VIOLATION','referent is not an authored character in committed content');
mutations.to: throw new ContentValidationError('referent is not an authored character in committed content');

limitations: Finite atom/list namespace corpus, not a general independent codec.
Direct qualification and decoded role admission intentionally have distinct structural-error precedence.
No whole-declaration or recursive record/map-key traversal qualification claim.
No global FCT-6, VAL, TRACE or PHEN-ADAPT closure.
